task.instruction: Grasp the orange block, orient its blue 2, and place it in the staging square.

limitations: catalogue packing envelope is not a precision CAD drawing
block.measurement_status: catalogue estimate, user piece not measured/weighed
block.orientation: printed face upward; original upright brick height runs along local+y toward studs

m15_mapping.camera_adjustment: M15 overhead raised to2.2m,36degree field of view; both views512px. Debug-run visual review found original overhead obscured. Common settings for both cohorts; M1 unchanged.
m15_mapping.controller: unchanged M1 privileged geometric expert; simulator truth used for execution and independent scoring
m15_mapping.endpoint_rule: two supported consecutive samples within first/last1.75s; dt0.3-0.75s, displacement<=0.12targetunits, yawchange<=10deg
m15_mapping.missing_observations: reject missing initial/final position or yaw; never replace initial with later post-action pose
m15_mapping.origin_status: supplied translation chosen before execution to fit M1 workspace; common to all personal examples
m15_mapping.plane_assumption: resting endpoint visible centroid approximates tabletop position; object top is elevated and centroid is not contact centre
m15_mapping.scale_status: engineering_layout_scale: one target-square unit represents M1 100mm staging square, not a measurement of real target
m15_mapping.source_coordinate_schema: raw pixels; normalized image; dimensionless target-unit homography

synthetic_control.matching: one independent draw per usable personal episode, matched category and robot/settings

m15_mapping.yaw_equation: project numeral-up vector through local homography; swap unit axes; yaw=atan2(-dx,dy)+world_rotation; retain directed 2pi angle
